answers.reason: The senate decides on statutes, structure, and strategy of the whole university, not matters handled by the administration.
Members of the administration work on the budget in the central or faculty administration, giving them a role in budget planning.
An appointment committee selects candidates for professorships, which is outside the remit of the administration.
A faculty council decides on faculty affairs and study regulations, which are not decided by the administration.
Members of the administration work on examinations, making them eligible for examination board matters.
